The characters within OFF are often entirely ambiguous and enigmatic. There are numerous central characters and villains, and throughout the game, the player will encounter many unnamed civilians. Motives and morals are often called into question, and it is not entirely clear whether any specific characters are particularly good-natured or evil, or if there are any ulterior motives behind either nature.
The player of the game is said to be a character too, as many references are made to the player being the omniscient controller of the puppet-like protagonist.
== Protagonists ==
=== The Puppeteer === The player of the game, or in other words, you. The player is never given a sprite or character. Rather, the player is given the role of guiding The Batter on his mission, and this control is acknowledged by the other characters. It is stated by The Batter at the beginning of the game that the player cannot speak to the characters but can see and hear.
=== [[The Batter]] === The Batter is the main protagonist and the playable character of the game. He has no talk voice, possibly implying his silent nature. He is determined to purify the zones of the world and will let no obstacle stand in his way. Although he is sentient and aware that he is a puppet being controlled by a person playing a game, he appears to think and feel independently - but he hardly ever shares his emotions or opinions. He takes on a relatively monstrous form during the Special Ending of OFF. This change, however, is merely the perspective of The Judge/Player and not a physical transformation.
=== [[Add-Ons|The Batter's Add-Ons]] === These are described as "peculiar objects,” “spiritual entities,” and "spherical" by the Judge. The Batter who, according to the Judge, has no "physical order" can get add-ons to join him, unlike the Judge. They fight alongside the Batter. Alpha, Omega, and Epsilon are conclusive all the add-ons the Batter obtains.
== Supporting Characters ==
=== [[Zacharie]] === Zacharie calls himself the "traditional items merchant" that is present in every video game. While his talk voice is the chuckling of a male, in [[Zone 3]] however, it's instead a "meow" when wearing the cat mask. He is the omnipresent trader from whom the Batter can buy weapons and items in exchange for credits. He seems to be interested in the Batter's progress and is aware that the Batter is being controlled by an otherworldly player. His signature speaking style consists of a constant breaking of the fourth wall and chuckling. He is the only character who is conscious of OFF's universe as being a video game and he refers to this point at various intervals throughout.
=== [[The Judge|The Judge/Pablo]] === The Judge is a talking, well-spoken cat assigned as the Batter's guardian at the beginning of the game. His talk voice is a purr of a cat. The Judge, at first, believes the Batter's mission to be futile, but follows him around the various zones, offering advice or help.
== Antagonists ==
=== [[Enemies|Spectres]] === Ghoulish ectoplasmic incarnations. The Batter was tasked with the sacred mission of purifying the land from these ghostly creatures. You will encounter them by the numbers in almost all of the Zones. What they are, why they are terrorizing the world of OFF and where are they coming from is a mystery as the focus of the game shifts towards other bigger things as the game progresses.
=== [[Dedan]] === Dedan is introduced as the Queen's supervisor. Later on, he reveals himself as the Guardian of [[Zone 1]].
He seems, from the start, to be a very aggressive character. He freely uses harsh language and almost everything he says is an insult or threat.
In The Room, Hugo refers to him as The Tall Mister.
=== [[Japhet]] === Japhet is the Guardian of [[Zone 2]] and the Library.
Many books in the library describe him and the story surrounding him. You can read the books in the Library to find out more about his backstory. They will explain that he is the creator and guardian of the library and has been turned into the form of a cat due to the spoken cat attempting to consume the bird, but not chewing properly, which The Judge recognizes as his brother, Valerie. You begin fighting him as a cat just like The Judge and then, as you fight, he reveals his true form of the bird with the skin of a cat hanging from his neck.
His death is linked to the death of another, and this situation highly upsets The Judge. This reaction is because the two are in a somewhat symbiotic relationship, and in purifying Japhet you also elicit feelings of sorrow in The Judge. The Judge will later be found at the top of the library calling out for his brother.
In The Room, Hugo refers to him as The Bird.
=== [[Enoch]] === Enoch is introduced as "The Director" and after a short discussion, reveals himself as the Guardian of Zone 3. His talk sound is a low-pitched laugh, voiced by [[Mortis Ghost]] himself.
He wears a white shirt, a black tie and a pair of black pants, like the Elsen. He is immediately recognizable because of his monumentally gigantic size, which The Batter comments on upon seeing him properly. However, despite his appearance, he is surprisingly fast and incredibly strong - some of Batter's attacks did not harm him at all, to the point where he was pushed to retreat.
Enoch does not appear to be very fit, and seems to have become much too comfortable in his little office deep in the middle of [[Zone 3]].
In [[The Room]], Hugo refers to him as The Big Mister.
=== [[Sugar]] === Sugar, or Sucré, is one of the two female characters in OFF and a hidden boss character. She can be found in the basement of [[Zone 0]] if you own at least one special item obtained from a [[Purified Zone|purified zone]]. She speaks in emoticons such as :-) or :-(. Beating her will give you the [[Items|Grand Chocolatier]]. It is implied that she and Zacharie have some backstory, due to his dialogue making him to appear to be sad once you have defeated Sugar.
=== [[The Queen|The Queen/Vader Eloha]] === A mysterious woman who appears to be the ruler of all Zones. She holds the name of Vader Eloha, which translates to "Father Christ".
Following the fight between The Queen and the Batter, she is the only character to house Add-Ons besides from The Batter, which are known as Delta, Sigma, and Ipsilon.
== [[Seraphic Incarnation|Seraphic Incarnations]] == Secret bosses who are exclusive to the remake that mostly appear in the Zones once they have been purified. Not much lore is given about them, so their relevance to the story and their own lore is highly unknown.
=== [[Source]] === Source is a lion, who can be found on top of a previously inaccessible building in Purified Zone 1. His character is shown to be very pacifistic, based off the dialogue and the fact that he doesn't directly attack in battle.
=== [[Maldicion]] === Maldicion is a giant crab who can be found in park in Purified Zone 2. He acts extremely chaotic, often switching topics and threatening the Batter than he "will crush his bones until all that's left is a stinky mash".
=== [[Psalmanazar & Herodotus]] === Two fish who are found in the purified Zone 3...
=== [[Justus]] ===
=== [[Carnival]] === Carnival is a Seraphic Incarnation that appears once Justus has been defeated, located in a special location in The Nothingness. It is unknown what they resemble, they have a minotaur-like appearance, possessing a tail, a crying mask to their torso and very deformed hands. They have an optimistic personality and sees the fight as a "dance" or a "game" (as directly seen by their attacks corresponding with games, which change with Leo, Cancer, Pisces, and Aquarius).
=== [[Cob]] === Cob is a ram who appears in a special room that is visible as a staircase before fighting Hugo, which only appears after beating all of the other Seraphic Incarnations. His personality appears to be somewhat nihilistic and seems to have a relationship with Source.
== Other Characters ==
=== [[Hugo]] === Hugo is a young, human child who appears in short cut-scenes each time a guardian is defeated, except for Enoch.
=== [[Valerie]] === Valerie is known to be the brother of The Judge, although he never actually made any appearance in the game himself. Japhet is first introduced inhabiting Valerie's body as a parasite, using him as a disguise.
=== [[Elsen]] === Inhabitants in Zone 1-3, and seen in some parts in The Room.
They are extraordinarily timid, to the extent at which they can be considered mildly to severely neurotic. Even the rustling of book pages is unsettling for (some of) them, and the sight of a Spectre is enough to send some of them into a state of panic.

[[HOUR HAND]] [[File:HOUR HAND.mp3]] }} '''Dedan''' is the [[Zone Guardians|Guardian]] of [[Zone 1]], and the first primary antagonist [[The Player]] and [[The Batter]] encounter in the game. == Official Description == ''Dedan is the Queen's inspector. His task consists of eliminating the phantoms that haunt Zone 1 (the land to which he is linked). His constant bad mood makes him a predictable, but not necessarily pleasant fellow. You have got to understand him, though, his zone would be perfect if it wasn't for all these accursed "apathetic idiots" that pollute the landscapes.'''' == Profile == === Physical Appearance === Dedan is a tall figure of an ambiguously skinny or muscular physique. His face is somewhat skeletal, as his mouth reaches to his eyes, where they are just small pupils in the darkness, with thick teeth. He has long, skinny arms alongside long fingers. He remains shirtless, has a white trench coat, white cargo shorts, black leggings, and shoes. === Personality === Dedan has a very rude and disrespectful personality. He regularly shows it to the Elsen in his zone, and keeps the same demeanor to The Batter, rudely asking him to get out of his Zone, thinking that protagonist is the chief of specters. Despite all that, he still tries to keep Elsen in his zone productive and working. === Lore === Dedan is Zone 1's Guardian, a role given to him by [[The Queen]]. He is described as the Queen's inspector - ruling with an iron fist resulting in the Elsens of his own zone fearing him. The player first encounters him as he scolds an Elsen, who let the Batter into the barn to defeat the spectres out of desperation. The Batter encounters Dedan in his own office after he just eliminated the spectres. [[OPERETTA OF 1000 LASHES]] [[File:OPERETTA OF 1000 LASHES.mp3]] }} '''Enoch''' is the [[Zone Guardians|Guardian]] of [[Zone 3]], and the third primary antagonist [[The Player]] and [[The Batter]] encounter in the game. == Profile == === Physical Appearance === Enoch is a gigantic large man with a round bald head, tiny ears, circular eyes, small gray cheeks that connect to his large mouth, wears a white business suit with a black tie, and black pants and shoes. === Personality === During the events shown in The Room, Enoch was an idealist, a charming eccentric, speaks gently especially to children, but also has an unsettling benevolence with an ideal future. As of now, Enoch is an extremely cold and condescending individual, completely unaffected by the countless deaths of his own workers in his Zone. He is also rather arrogant, as he seems to love the metaphor referring to the [[Zone Guardians|Guardians]] as being comparative to "Gods". He doesn't consider any strengths that the [[The Batter|Batter]] may have, showing that he truly believes that he is invincible as well as a higher power in comparison to everyone else. === Lore === Like the other Guardians, Enoch uses a crass method of controlling his Elsen. Enoch provides each Elsen with sugar in small, consistent rations. Sugar is described by one of the Elsen as "the most important element", stating that without sugar, the mental health of all Elsen would deteriorate, eventually transforming them into Burnt. However, this is not necessarily the case, as sugar is not seen in any of the other Zones, and no other Elsen outside of Zone 3 seems to display signs of the substance's effect. Sugar is observed to have addictive effects on the Elsen, as several of them display addictive tendencies within their dialogue in addition to their already existent neurotic disposition. Certain posters within Zone 3 allude to cases of the Elsen sneaking sugar with them off to their beds in an attempt to hoard it. In one particular moment, the Batter encounters Elsen actually fighting and defeating numerous spectres in a surprisingly uncharacteristic way for the average Elsen, only for it to come forth that the effect of sugar has some strong side effects including increased hostility and violence, even from the overly timid Elsen. The production of sugar is shown to involve burning the corpses of Elsen. Enoch has stated that burning these bodies produces Spectres, which may relate to the "Burnt" enemies that are formed from Elsen. He encourages Elsen to befriend or ignore the Specters that roam around with the use of misleading posters, which makes it easy for the Spectres to kill them and increase sugar production. In the [[The Room|Room]], the Batter encounters an entity called The Big Mister, which appears to be a version of Enoch before the events which resulted in his becoming of a Guardian. The Big Mister is a very jolly, patient person, completely contrary to the personality of Enoch. When the Batter meets him, he finds that The Big Mister is caught in a sinkhole; The Big Mister begs The Batter to help him out and gives him the promise that he will be rewarded with cakes if he helps. Giving the orchid book to The Bird will prompt him to summon many birds, which lift The Big Mister out of the hole he is trapped in. The Big Mister is exceedingly thankful, telling the Batter he will "bake [him] those cakes," and that he will "drown [him] in an ocean of sweets". This could be a reason as to why Enoch produces sugar in his Zone. == Competences == {| class="wikitable" style="width: 50%" |- !Name !Description |- |style="width: 15%"|Inciting Incident |style="width: 40%"|Single target. |- | Spurred Moment | Self target. File:7-006.png|The Batter encountering Enoch in his office. == Trivia == * According to Mortis Ghost, Enoch is one of four humans; also including [[Zacharie]], [[Sugar]] and [[Hugo]]. * He appears to be on bad terms with the [[The Queen|Queen]] as he seems to firmly believe that the Batter was sent by the Queen to eliminate him. It's also implied that the Queen has tried more than once to get rid of Enoch as Enoch states that "Naturally, it's the Queen. It has got to be her". * If the Batter (and his Add-ons) is over-leveled enough, then defeating Enoch's first form is actually possible. It does not affect the actual game, as you will still need to defeat him a second time since the player was never supposed to defeat him at this point of the game. * The French version of the game seems to imply that as with the [[The Judge|Judge]] and [[Zacharie]], Enoch seems to be "self-aware" and know that the world of ''OFF'' is merely a game. In the English version, during Enoch's 2nd and final battle sequence, he says "your game is nearing its end, Batter", which could be interpreted as him telling the Batter that his death is close. In the French version, however, he says "Le Game Over est proche, Batteur" which more closely translates to "Game Over is near, Batter". The fact that the word "Game Over" is capitalized could be emphasizing that Enoch did indeed know that this was all a video game and that he knew the concept of a "Game Over". * According to the game's end credits, Enoch's "voice" sounds are produced by Mortis Ghost. * Enoch in [[OF]] acts differently than his arrogant god characterization in OFF at Zone 3, as he resembles more of the Big Mister in "''Chapter 4 I had three friends''" during [[The Room]] segment. == References == TBA

OF is an official prequel comic to [[OFF]]. 4 pages were first shown in the [https://www.fangamer.com/products/off-collectors-edition-game-nintendo-switch OFF Bad Human Edition] product in the Fangamer store website before the remaster was published. The full comic was released on March 27th, 2026, consisting of sixteen pages overall.
The comic centers in the beginning of the OFF world, prior to the game's events, especially around [[Hugo]] and [[The Queen]], whom [[The Judge]] befriends.
== Sypnosis ==
== Plot == The comic begins in an empty land, [[The Judge|Pablo]] stumbles onto a broken train, wondering if it could be fixed. A boy who sees the train approaches and introduces himself as [[Hugo]]. Pablo introduces himself and, off guard by the unexpected child, asks him what he's doing there. The boy replies that he's waiting for his [[Queen|mum]]. He then explains that she is traveling the world and asks where the train goes after he gets on. The cat answers that it doesn't go anywhere. Hugo explains that his mother can fix the train and calls her a magician. Pablo is fascinated. Hugo gets off the train and invites Pablo to come back tomorrow. Pablo accepts, lets Hugo pet him, and then departs, leaving Hugo alone.
As the birds chirp outside of [[Zone 2]], Pablo and his younger brother, [[Valérie]], are walking in the library. Pablo tells Valérie that Hugo's mother is very powerful, which intrigues Valérie. Pablo explains that he, too, was impressed by his mother's abilities, believing they could rebuild the world. He tries to invite his brother over, but Valérie hesitates and mentions it sounds like a cult. Pablo is shocked and strongly denies it. The two walk upstairs. Pablo mentions a friendly boy named Hugo is involved, but Valérie ignores him due to being distracted by a bird flying outside the window, and he thinks of hunger. Pablo suggests Hugo might please Valérie and still tries to invite him over. Still, Valérie refuses again, Pablo expresses quiet annoyance, and Valérie continues that he doesn't like meeting new people and that it is merely Pablo's thing. Then, the two go to the library rooftop, with Valérie suggesting bird hunting. When Pablo asks if he told Valérie about the mother's abilities, he confirms it.
Pablo and Hugo are already at the riverbank. Pablo realizes the surroundings have become vivid, and Hugo agrees. Hugo sees it as colorful, but admits it is mostly yellow, a remark Pablo accepts as a compliment. Hugo points out that the surroundings look more square-shaped than before and that the shapes of objects have changed. Pablo notices this immediately. The two sit on the stage. Hugo confides in his friend that he is not feeling well and relays that his mother said it is nothing serious, but it is safer at home. Seeing that Hugo looks healthy, Pablo asks if there is anything he can do to help. Hugo hesitates but then asks Pablo if he could throw a party. Pablo jumps over Hugo's head and is delighted to imagine everyone enjoying themselves. The two thank each other and gaze at the sunset.
Someone knocks on Hugo's door. When an [[Elsen]] opens the door, he sees [[Enoch]], a large man, outside holding a pie for Hugo. the Elsen is nervously surprised and explains that it is due to the Queen's order prohibiting visitors. Sadly, Enoch asks if at least the pie could be delivered to Hugo. The Elsen trembles even more as he realizes that it is impossible. The Queen orders that no one can touch Hugo, and memories of him will be erased so everyone won't be sad. Enoch ironically replies that the concept sounds sad. The Elsen finds comfort in those words as Enoch leaves, resulting in the Elsen taking notice and tries calling him out, he is then seen by [[Zone 3]]’s river, eating the pie in sadness.
At [[Zone 0]], [[Zacharie]] comments that the area is yellow. Valérie added it’s also square. Pablo confidently declared that it was the beginning of his work, which he refers to as a humble cat. Valérie reluctantly admitted that it was beautiful, and Zacharie said it was impressive. Pablo accepted the compliments and invited him inside without further delay. He happily took them out for a walk inside, and the trio went up to the rooftop of the Zone 0 building. The felines are near the left side of the rooftop alone while Zacharie walks on the other side. Pablo noticed his brother's quiet gaze and asked about it, as he took note that his brother was not really participating. Valérie turned his face away, commenting that his meal disagreed with him. He explained that Zero 0 was beautiful but that he didn't feel like himself, and Pablo felt obliged. Valérie changed the subject and asked about Hugo, leaving Pablo bewildered, and asked what boy?T

A remastered and officially translated remake was announced in June of 2025, to be released on Windows PC and Nintendo Switch. It was released on Steam and digitally on Switch on August 15th, 2025, but the physical Switch version was delayed and released on March 27, 2026.

[[SAGITTARIUS]] }} The Infinite Valley is a location in OFF, notably not being any of the Zones. It can be accessed through a black portal in [[The Nothingness]] after defeating [[Justus]], and it contains [[Carnival]], one of the [[Seraphic Incarnation|Seraphic Incarnations]]. == Interior == The Infinite Valley is a yellow place with rocks laying on the ground. On the north of it is the end of the cliff, on which an eye is placed. When talked with, it is revealed to be [[Carnival|Carnival.]] From the cliff there's a view on the black abyss below. == Storyline == After beating [[Justus]], the player gains access to The Infinite Valley. This location consists of one single room, in which [[Carnival]] can be fought. Besides fighting [[Carnival]], there's no points of interest in this location. After beating [[Carnival]] and leaving The Infinite Valley, black portal that led into it disappears from [[The Nothingness|The Nothingness.]]

Pablo, also known as '''The Judge''' is the [[Zone Guardians|Guardian]] of [[Zone 0]], and the deuteragonist of [[OFF]]. == Official Description ==
''The Judge proves a very precious help for visitors in the world of OFF - The Zones hold no secrets for him. He is easily recognizable by his big ears, his sharp canine teeth and his soft fur (of which he is quite proud). Notified of your presence before you even installed OFF, he is the first character to welcome you to this world. But do be careful, for his companionable appearance hides a formidable fighter!''''
== Profile == === Physical Appearance === The Judge is a white cat with an unusually large head and club-like tail. He has a distinct, large smile with protruding canines and oval-shaped eyes with rounded slit pupils. His eyes are often white, but have been depicted as red in official merch.https://www.fangamer.eu/products/the-judge-off-shirt?_pos=1&_psq=heral&_ss=e&_v=1.0 === Personality === The Judge has a habit of speaking very verbosely compared to other characters, something that [[Zacharie]] later adopts when he has to take over for The Judge in [[Zone 3]]. His behaviour often mimics that of a regular housecat. He is generally optimistic and trusting of other people, choosing to see only the best in people until he is proven wrong, a stark contrast to [[Valerie]]. Like [[Zacharie]], Pablo addresses [[The Player]] and [[The Batter]] as separate entities, talking to each as an individual rather than as one unit. He becomes frustrated when he feels as if he isn't being listened to, this is shown during the battle tutorial if you ignore his instructions. === Lore === The Judge is the first character met by The Batter at the beginning of the game and is the one to teach The Player battle mechanics. He serves as a companion who appears at random times in both [[Zone 1]] and [[Zone 2]] to offer assistance to The Batter. The Judge drops out of the story after The Batter purifies [[Zone 2]], he is replaced by Zacharie in [[Zone 3]] who explains that he is mourning the loss of his brother. When revisiting purified Zone 2, The Judge can be seen circling the top of the library where [[Japhet]] was defeated, meowing into nothing. In [[The Room]], he returns before The Batter can flip the switch and offers The Player the choice to stay with The Batter and destroy the world or side with him and stop The Batter before he can complete his sacred mission. If The Player sides with The Batter they will fight The Judge, killing him and flipping the switch to the "OFF" position. After this, the game ends. If The Player sides with The Judge they will fight [[The Batter (Boss)|The Batter]]. Upon his defeat, The Batter states that The Judge is too late and The Judge responds that he prefers living with the destruction left behind over letting The Batter finish his mission. After this, the game ends. He is seen walking along the purified zones between the credits. In the OF comic, it's revealed that The Judge had a friendly relationship with Hugo before the creation of the new world, even promising to throw him a party in Zone 0 once he recovers from his illness. '''Valérie''' is the younger brother of [[The Judge]] that can be found in [[Zone 2]].
== Profile == === Physical Appearance === Valérie is a white cat vaguely resembling The Judge. In his sprite and facecard his teeth are straight, his eyes appear more circular and his head is a more rectangular shape than Pablo's. His ears are longer and his tail appears to fade to black near the end. In the OF comic he resembles The Judge much more closely, with only his teeth changing to a solid frown with a tooth gap.
=== Personality === Little is properly known about Valérie's personality. However, he seems to be much more skittish than his brother. He has difficulty meeting new people and lacks trust in others, suspecting Pablo to be falling for a cult when he talks about [[Hugo]] and [[The Queen]] in the OF comic.
Valérie also seems to be overly compassionate, Mortis Ghost claimed in a DeviantArt comment that the reason he didn't chew [[Japhet]]'s body was because he was too nice.<ref>https://www.deviantart.com/comments/4/3470838/3058713420</ref> This is mentioned again in another DeviantArt comment where Mortis Ghost describes him as "a nice little cat".<ref>https://www.deviantart.com/comments/4/3470838/3042942364</ref>
=== Lore === Valérie himself is never met in OFF, as [[The Batter]] finds his body being controlled by Japhet in [[Zone 2]]. Whether or not Valérie is still alive before Japhet transforms is unclear.
Valérie is implied to have been living in [[Zone 0]] with The Judge before wandering off. In Zone 2, Pablo expresses concern for his wellbeing under the impression that he is delusional, unaware that Japhet has taken control of him.

Cat Mask [[File:ZachMaw April2025.ogg]] |song = None }} "The characters are starting to pile up, aren't they?" '''Zacharie''' is a merchant in [[OFF]]. He can be found throughout the game selling various [[Items]]. == Official Description ==
''Zacharie is the official merchant of OFF - the only one, in fact. However, his business is not one of the most flourishing ones: only heroes are willing to buy artifacts from mysterious strangers. No one really knows where all the items he offers are coming from, nor how he even got hold of them, but as a video game player, you probably couldn't care less about it, could you?''''
== Profile == === Physical Appearance === Zacharie has white skin and messy black hair. He has a white shirt with a heart as well as black pants. He's always seen wearing a toad mask, which conceals his facial expressions at all times. === Personality === Zacharie is kind, caring, spontaneous and "A really chill dude". He regularly breaks the fourth wall, even more so than [[The Judge]], directly addressing [[The Player]] while speaking to them through [[The Batter]]. Fully aware that he is in a videogame. This knowledge of the world does not visibly deter him however - as he appears to genuinely enjoy his role as the merchant of [[OFF]]. Helping The Player and The Batter both directly and indirectly throughout the game. He's somewhat of an antihero, pursuing the continual acquisition of credits and items. In [[Zone 3]], he offers to trade a hint to a puzzle for a [https://off.miraheze.org/wiki/Items#Unique_items Music Box] that The Player has acquired, although does not seem concerned if The Player declines. Even commending them on solving the puzzle later if they return to him with the item in question. When faced with a serious situation however, he has been shown to quickly jump into action. As an example, he's willing to replace others temporarily - such as [[The Judge]] - by wearing a mask of him in [[Zone 3]]. Replacing his role and allowing him time to grieve over the death of his brother, [[Valerie]]. Later in the game he also expresses sadness over the death of [[Sugar]], conflicted over the circumstances that led to her death. == Lore == Zacharie has existed in the world of OFF since before the apocalypse. It is not told explicitly in-game how he survived, became a merchant, or gained the knowledge that he was in a videogame.
Although, Mortis Ghost suggested in a livestream that he could have used a bunker or his fourth wall breaking powers. After the apocalypse, Zacharie presumably began working with [[The Guardians]] starting at an unknown time to help improve the quality of life in The Zones. He showed up in [[OF]] he made a cameo when [[the Judge]] was giving him and Valerie a tour to [[Zone 0]]. His main contribution would be [[The Amusement Park]] in [[Zone 2]]. A solution for the [[Elsen]] becoming [[Burnt]] out after high stress. This worked at the start. However, after the creation of a loud balloon game and a rollercoaster which had to be shut down, Zacharie would lose interest and leave a lone Elsen to guard the entrance to his office while he wandered elsewhere. Which leads up to the present when the game takes place. Where Zacharie would meet [[The Player]] and [[The Batter]] while lurking in the office annex of Shachihata. Commencing his role as the omnipresent merchant in the game. == Dialogue == '''(First Encounter, [[Zone 1]])''' ''"The characters are starting to pile up, aren't they?"'' [[The Batter]]: ''Pardon?'' ''"What I'm saying is that the average player doesn't need all these complicated and tedious dialogues."'' ''"There should be more action and fewer questions."'' [[The Batter]]: ''Who are you?'' ''"I'm Zacharie, the traditional items merchant that's necessary in every video game."'' ''"I'll always find myself in places you're going to visit before you arrive."'' ''"But enough blether. I'm not one of those protagonists you need to listen to for hours."'' ''"So, lemme see the color of your credits."'' '''(Post-First Encounter, [[Zone 0]])''' ''"He he he, yep, I'm here too."'' ''"On an unrelated note, it's been a while since I've seen [[The Judge|Pablo]] around here."'' '''(Second Encounter, [[Zone 1]])''' ''"Hello [entered name] ! In good shape? ... Perhaps you have some spare credits?"'' '''(Third Encounter, [[Zone 2]])''' ''"Buenos dias, dear [entered name]. Where's a better place to shop than a shopping mall?"'' '''(Fourth Encounter, [[Zone 2]])''' ''"Nice view from up here, don't you think? It almost makes me forget that this is only a video game."'' '''(First Encounter (''Judge ver.''), [[Zone 3]])''' ''"Good day, dear reckless accomplice!"'' ''"I've somewhat changed, anatomically speaking... But you have obviously recognized me at first glance! I'm your friend, the [[Judge]]!"'' [[The Batter]]: ''Zacharie?'' ''"..."'' ''"So my disguise is no match for your keen and unforgiving eyesight..."'' ''"[[Pablo]] isn't really in top-form as the moment."'' ''"I'm going to replace him for some time."'' ''"Anyway, I'll be hunting down obscure clues that I shall take pleasure in revealing to you little by little in the most destructive manner."'' ''"Ah ah ah, I can already smell the good times!"'' [[The Batter]]: ''...'' ''"Are you going for a stroll near the dormitories in the meantime? I've heard the spectres there are quite active."'' '''If interacted with again:''' ''"The dorms are on the upper left of the cafeteria. It's right next door."'' ''"Go and check it out. You may find some interesting clues."'' [[The Batter]]: ''What clues?'' ''"..."'' ''"... Talk to me when you're done."'' == Dialogue (OF) == [[The Judge|Judge]]: Has there ever been a view to match it? Zacharie: It's very yellow. [[Valerie]]:...And Square. [[The Judge|Judge]]: Ah, but this is only the beginning! The work of just one humble cat! [[Valerie]]: Yes, I suppose it is very nice. Zacharie: Actually quite impressive, I must say. [[The Judge|Judge]]: Thank you, Zacharie. But you must see the interior! File:ZacharieOF.jpg|Zacharie's OF appereance. == Trivia == * According to Mortis Ghost, Zacharie is one of four humans; also including [[Enoch]], [[Sugar]] and [[Hugo]]. * Interestingly enough, in [[The Library]] there exists a book called "Tales and Legends - The Story of The Toad King". It details the story of a Masked Man who slew a Toad King. It's not specified in-game whether this is Zacharie or an ancestor and it's left entirely up to player interpretation. === Livestreams === * During the OFF 10th Anniversary Livestream, Mortis Ghost answered several questions related to Zacharie. Listed below are the answers which seem to be the most interesting. ** Q: What is Zacharie's zodiac sign? *** The crab sign! (Cancer)
''(Editor's Note: The Cancer Card is represented by [[Maldicion]] in the remaster.)'' ** Q: Do you imagine Zacharie as disgusting and weird or do you just imagine him as a chill dude? *** A really chill dude. ** Q: How tall is Zacharie? *** Precisely? IDK. ** Q: Does Zacharie like the Batter? *** Yes, I think he's quite a nice guy. He likes a lot of people. ** Q: Is Zacharie named after archangel Zachariel? *** Yes, a lot of characters in this game have biblical names. ** Q: Have you ever thought of making a Zacharie boss fight while developing the game? *** No, I never thought about it. There is no reason to fight Zacharie since he's a good guy, and I think he would be overpowered. ** Q: Does Zacharie have more masks and does he make them himself? *** We could imagine he has more masks, like a big collection with all of his friends in case one of them is sick and he has to replace them. ** Q: What does Zacharie's face look like? *** I don't know, I didn't draw his face. * Here are a couple more questions he answered, this time from the OFF 15th Anniversary Livestream. ** Q: How is Zacharie doing, what are his views on the world? *** He is not well, he is quite nihilistic and sees the world is not doing well, but he doesn’t care. ** Q: How far does Zacharie’s self awareness go? *** He knows he is in a videogame, and being in the videogame OFF is quite depressing.
He knows everything, he knows about The Batter and his powers. ** Q: We saw the story of The Guardians but what about Zacharie, Judge, and Valerie? Did they exist before the zones? *** Yes they did exist before the zones, and they survived the apocalypse somehow, maybe in a bunker. Maybe because Judge and Valerie have 9 lives as cats they came back to life, and Zacharie’s 4th wall breaking power allowed him to survive. ** Q: What is Zacharie and Sugar’s relationship? Are they friends? A couple? *** They like each other, but as you prefer. If you want them together then sure. But he doesn’t have any thought on it. == References == Unproductive FunTime. [[LE DERNIER PETIT SUCRE]] }} Zone 0 (also called Joas) is the first area in the game. This zone acts as a tutorial for the player and teaches the player how to do various things like controlling [[The Batter]], combat, and solving puzzles. This zone is very small compared to the other zone in the game, and lacks any signs of life other than [[The Judge]], [[Sugar]], and [[Zacharie]]. It's never explained as to why this zone lacks much of the life that the other zones have. It is also implied that [[Valerie]] may have once resided in Zone 0 with [[The Judge]]. == Items, Interactables & Secrets == There are two chests outside the main building, these contain a [[Items|Luck Ticket]] and a piece of [[Items|Silver Flesh]]. There are several cube puzzles throughout the main building, as well as [[Zacharie]] being found on the first floor after meeting him for the first time in the end of mines of Pentel, an area in [[Zone 1]]. There is a red save Cube behind the main building. In the basement of the main building (which is accessable after obtaining 1 of the five grand [[items]]) Sugar can be fought. == Gallery == File:OFF Promotional Art Zone 0.png|''"Enter Zone 0?"'' [[HOUR HAND]] }} Zone 1 is the second Zone that [[The Batter]] gains access to after obtaning a [[Items|Leo Card]] from [[The Judge|The Judge.]] It's guardian is [[Dedan]]. == Storyline == === Elsen === When [[The Batter]] enters Zone 1, he is spawned in the Elsen, which is considered the first section of the first Zone. A red box is placed to the right, and walking north will teleport [[The Batter]] to a tramway station. From there you can get into a tram and travel to the Damien. === Damien === After The Batter arrives into Damien, he can proceed southbound, and upon doing so, he will be met with a small house and a mining site. An [[Elsen]] will initiate a conversion with [[The Batter]] as he comes near the house, welcoming the latter and questioning [[The Batter|The Batter's]] goals to which [[The Batter]] responds that he is here to eradicate the impure spirits. After this [[Elsen]] explains the nature of smoke, and how people here obtain it. Afterwards, [[The Batter]] makes his way into a mine to the south, in which he finds [[Add-Ons|Alpha]] and [[The Judge]], the latter explains to him the nature of [[Add-Ons|Add-ons]]. Alpha joins [[The Batter]] in his purificatory quest, after which the protagonist once again talks with the [[Elsen]], who gives [[The Batter]] access to the main mines. Entering the mines, [[The Batter]] is attacked by spectres, which he purifies, commenting on the usefulness of [[Add-Ons|Alpha's]] presense afterwards. From now on, it's possible to proceed through the mines until some cubes, blocking the path to the east. Conviently enough, there's a ladder nearby which grants the protagonist access to Pentel. === Pentel === After leaving the mines, [[The Batter]] finds himself in the farms of Pentel, as a different [[Elsen]] approaches him, explaining the nature of metal element, and asks him to purify the barns. In barns, [[The Batter]] will find 5 different [[Enemies|Fat Spectres]] alongside some [[Enemies|Ah ah!s]]. After purifying all the spectres and attempting to leave the barns, the player will watch a cutscene which shows [[Dedan]] first time in the game, who asks a following him [[Elsen]] how long [[The Batter]] has been in the barns, and shows his belief in the fact that [[The Batter]] will simply die while fighting the spectres, leaving afterwards. [[The Batter]] comes out of the barns and asks an Elsen who is [[Dedan]]. After a short dialogue showing Batter's intent on destroying Dedan, Batter is then asked by an Elsen to continue purifying mines, and give up on an idea of destroying Dedan, as well as mentioning the fact that [[Dedan]] now went to Alma. Entering mines again, the cubes blocking the way to the east are now gone, however the lamps in the next section of mines are broken. This situation is even more worsened by the fact that there are cubes blocking the way once again. [[The Batter]] needs to find a switch that will make the cubes disappear. To do so, protagonist can go east, then north, ignore the path to the east and go north again, then go west and then south, finally meeting with the switch. After this, the cubes blocking the path will disappear, and it's now needed to go north, and then east until the section with broken lamps will finally be over. Going through the section of mines with broken lamps will result in [[The Batter]] meeting [[Zacharie]] first time in the game, and then getting to the basement of Shachihata. === Shachihata === Entering the basement, [[The Batter]] meets an [[Elsen]], who doesn't believe that protagonist came throught the mines since all lamps are broken in the mines, but then announces that this place is Shachihata, as well as explaining the nature of plastic element and pointing the place where all spectres come from, which is revealed to be postal service, howeverno one remembers the number of the floor on which it can be found. [[The Batter]] now can proceed into different floors of the building, but the most interesting ones is floor 00000 which is the basement where [[The Batter]] came from, floor 00001 which is ground floor, floor ????? which is Postal Service, and floor 99999 which is the roof. Upon travelling to the roof through an elevator, [[The Batter]] will once again meet with [[The Judge]], the latter giving an advice on how to figure out the floor postal service can be found on. After going to the south west room in the ground floor and talking with one of the employees, one can figure out the postal service floor is 10258. Upon travelling there, the floor appears to be empty, but after going to the east towards stairs, an [[Elsen]] will walk down from them, appearing to be Burnt, and after a short conversation the employee will attack [[The Batter]]. After the fight protagonist can proceed towards the upper floors, finding some paper along the way. Each sheet of paper has a different text on it, giving some hints to the code that will be asked on the floor 10258.75 by an [[Elsen]]. After saying the code (681452) [[Elsen]] will get scared for his life, probably because he might get killed for letting someone pass. No matter the reason for their fear, they will attack [[The Batter]]. Winning the fight allows you to enter director's office, in which [[Dedan]] will be found. He fights off spectres and then notices [[The Batter]], thinking that he is the leader of spectres. The latter then proves [[Dedan]] wrong, calling himself the purifier and saying that he is here to kill all the spectres instead of ruling over them. [[Dedan]] doesn't believe it, commanding [[The Batter]] to leave Zone 1 and "take his spectres along with him", or he will be killed. [[Dedan]] then disappears, and the tramway now can stop in Alma, which was unaccesible beforehand. === Alma === Upon getting into Alma by a tram, [[The Batter]] can enter a passageway into the main area. In it, a single [[Elsen]] is standing at the end of the room, asking [[The Batter]] some questions for him to be allowed to pass. Nearby there's three paper sheets on the wall, all of which contain answers to the questions. Answers are as follows: 1. The third from Orta, 2. Roses, 3. Six, 4. 22, 5. Jonas. The answer to the final question is 87. After correctly answering all of the questions, [[The Batter]] will be attacked by a Burnt once again. Once the pathway is open The Batter can finally proceed throught it. Upon doing so, an [[Elsen]] will approach protagonist, explaining the nature of meat, as well as telling about [[Dedan|Dedan's]] office, which is located in the center of the Alma. After the explanation, [[Elsen]] challenges [[The Batter]] to liberate him and start a battle. Proceeding northbound, the player can once again meet [[Zacharie]], and is able to freely buy items from him. [[Dedan|Dedan's]] outpost's entrance appears to be closed off by blocks. Going to the right will allow [[The Batter]] to find a pedalo, and travel through the meat rivers on it. After doing a puzzle with cubes, the pathway into [[Dedan|Dedan's]] outpost wil open. Entering the office, player will see 4 paths into west, south, north and east respectively. Player needs to listen to the path from where the theme song gets louder, and go into it. The pattern is: West, North, East, East, South, West, North, North. After it, protagonist will be met with a red cube and a chest, containing a [[Items|Joker]]. After going into the door to the north, [[The Batter]] will confront [[Dedan]]. After a brief conversation, the fight will begin. When [[The Batter]] appears victorious and [[Dedan]] lies dead, the zone becomes pure and player can watch a cutscene involving [[Hugo]], after which [[The Batter]] is teleported back into [[The Nothingness]]. == Lore == Zone 1 is the main source of metal, smoke, plastic and meat in the world of OFF, and from there, the elements are transported to other zones. It's exterior is mostly green, while the mines and interiors of buildings are purple. The Elsen in the zone are usually seen calm or sometimes in fear, which is usually caused by dangerous specters or this zone's guardian, Dedan, who is rude and disrespectful towards his workers. Dedan himself, however, isn't absolutely evil and he still cares about his zone's well being, killing the specters in his office and telling The Batter to get out of the zone and take his specters along with him. == Items, Interactables & Secrets == In Elsen, there's a red cube east from the starting point, a tram to the north and an [[Elsen]] NPC near the tram. In Damien, there's an [[Elsen]] NPC right near the tram station, various [[Elsen]] NPCs in the mining site, a [[Items|Luck Ticket]] in the chest in the house, as well as a [[Items|Joker]] chest hidden behind the walls before entering the mines, a chest which contains "Zone 1" pillar art, a yellow cube in the room where [[The Batter]] fought the spectres first time, a passage to the north that becomes accesible after gaining access to Pentel's mines, containing [[Items|1 orb of each type]]. There's also various [[Elsen]] NPC's working in the mines and chests scattered throught the mines, them containing a [[Items|Joker]] and two pieces of [[Items|Belial's Meat]]. There's a hidden room to the westnorth, which can be opened by interacting with a torch that doesn't emit light. In the room, 3 [[Elsen]] NPC's can be found as well as 3 pieces of [[Items|Belial's Meat.]] In Pentel, to the west of the center of the farms, theres an off colored tile. Stepping on it will cause a green fish with annoying dog's face from Undertale to emerge from the water, and fall back into it, however this has no real use besides being a reference. There's a yellow cube near the barns, as well a lot of [[Elsen]] NPCs scattered around the area. Going into the mines, there's a chest to the north, containing a [[Items|Silver Flesh]]. Going east, north and east again will result in finding a chest, containing two [[Items|Luck Tickets]]. Going north till the dead end will result in finding a chest with [[Items|Abaddon's Meat]]. In Shachihata, leaving the floor 00000 and going into mines a bit, there's a yellow cube to the east, as well as [[Zacharie]] standing west of it. Going to floor 87666, [[The Batter]] will find himself in Secret Service floor, finding [[Zacharie]] (if he was talked with in floor 00000), who will reward him with a [[Items|Taurus Orb]] that he had in his mouth (according to his dialogue). On the floor 02458 Lost Service is located. To the north of the floor, there's two chests located, the chest to the east containing an [[Items|Abaddon's Meat]] and the chest to the west being impure and initiating a battle with specters when interacted with. After the battle, a [[Items|Luck Ticket]] will be found. On floor 10258 (postal service) going to the ladder to the floor 10258.5, proceeding east on the floor,and then down the ladder there a chest with an [[Items|Aura of Juctice]], which can be bought from [[Zacharie]] on floor 00000. In Alma, on the center of the area, there's a yellow cube and [[Zacharie]] standing to the east of it. East of the center, there's a chest containing a [[Items|Silver Flesh]]. It can be accessed with a pedalo north of it. [[PHOENIX]] }} Zone 2 is the third zone that [[The Batter]] gains access to after obtaining a Cancer Card from a defeated [[Dedan]]. It's guardian is [[Japhet]]. == Storyline == ==== Center ==== Entering the zone, [[The Batter]] can go north, entering the city of Bismark, colored in pink. In the center of it is a library, with an arrow that shows in which side of the city you are currently in. To access each side's respective area you need to go south. If the arrow points down, going south will lead you back from where you entered Bismark after appearing there from The Nothingness. If the arrow points right, going south will lead you to the entrance into Residential Area. If the arrow point to the left, going south will lead you into the western area of the city, which has an open way to the plastic rivers and a way to Amusument Park, however The Batter can't access it immediately after entering the zone due to the plastic's flidity, and a pedalo cannot be found nearby. If the arrow point up, going south will lead you to the entrance of Gomez Galleria. Arrows will change when going to the west and east of the center respectively. After just entering the zone, however, The Batter's only point of interest is the library's reception. ==== Grand Library ==== Proceeding southbound (if you just entered the zone and was only going south so far), a library will be entered, where [[The Batter]] will watch a cutscene. After it ends, talking with a receptionist on the first floor will result in [[The Batter]] gaining access to the third floor. A puzzle must be done there, where you need to put pages in their respective books, judging by the symbols on the pages. One page, however, cannot be found on the bookshelves of the third floor, and instead needs to be bought for 100 credits from an [[Elsen]], who can be found on the western side of the city. He looks like an ordinary NPC, so it's easy to miss him. After inserting all the pages and talking once again with the receptionist, The Batter is free to proceed to the higher floors. After going one hallway and then another one, a cat will walk from the upper floors. [[The Batter]] comments on the fact that this cat isn't [[The Judge]], before the cat claims himself to be [[Japhet]] and the leader of the specters, before saying that protagonist definitely has a certain courage within him, which however doesn't stop him from attacking [[The Batter]]. After defeating [[Japhet]], he will teleport away, and Omega, second [[Add-Ons|add-on]] met in the game will appear. Interacting with it will result in it joining protagonist in his journey. Cubes will block the path to higher floors of library, so the only thing left to do is go down the library and seek [[The Judge]], who can be found in the center of the city where an arrow on the library points down. He will tell [[The Batter]] that a shopping mall is haunted by specters, which is the next point of interest. (how to access it is explained in Center sub paragraph) ==== Gamez Galleria ==== When the mall is entered, The Batter is met with Zacharie standing to the north (he can be accessed instantly after entering Zone 2, so you can get better equipment immediately after entering Zone 2 without having to go to Grand Library first.) and a pathway to the northeast which can be accessed only after talking to The Judge in the center. Going through it will lead to a giant maze like area, and after going through it, The Batter will be once again meet The Judge. After a conversion with the latter in which he praises an adversiment on the wall and tells protagonist to give Valerie (who is revealed to be Judge's brother) a greeting if the former will meet him sometime, a pedalo that was unaccesible beforehand can be summoned in the west part of Bismark, allowing to go to Amusument Park. ==== Amusement Park ==== Entering Amusument Park, The Batter will have access to three attractions, a pedalo ride to the east, a balloon popping game to the north, and roller-coaster to the west, which however is shut down. To turn it on you need to flip a switch in pedalo ride. Pedalo ride and roller-coaster are completely optional (details are in Items, Interactables & Secrets paragraph, which is still WIP) however balloon popping game isn't. In it player will need to play against an Elsen, taking turns and popping one, two or three baloons. Total amount of balloons is 13, and whoever's turn is when one balloon is left will lose. To win, it must be Elsen's turn when the amount of balloons left is 5. Winning will make Elsen go crazy, attacking The Batter. After the fight, a Necktie will be found and the Elsen in the center of the park will be incredibly scared for their lives. However, it allows The Batter to go into Residential Area if Necktie will be used in the area entrance room, making protagonist put on the Necktie. ==== Residential Area ==== In the entrance to Residential Area, The Batter must put on Necktie found in Amusument Park which will grant him access to the Residential Area. Entering it, player will see a cutscene where Valerie, after being ignored by surrounding Elsen summons spectres to kill everyone in the area. The Batter must purify the specters in the city in a limit of 4 minutes. Timer is stopped when combat starts or inventory is opened. After all the specters are killed, Elsen will thank The Batter for saving them, however, they will also ask protagonist to leave the area, making the point that his bat is a dangerous object. Leaving the area, The Judge will be found, who asks for help, as his dear brother Valerie has gone mad, calling himself Japhet and resting on the roof of Grand Library.
